sourceDecision.evidenceClass: Correction within the approved compact-disclosure design (6014/e733): return focus to the invoking account action, retain a connected Add provider fallback, and place existing recipes with the existing models controls. Reuse ProviderDetailForm and ProviderDetailSections; do not create a second models home. Recipe fetching is independent of billing and remains server-owned behind Suspense, with provider-wide attribution on additional accounts. Preserve all authentication, model, billing and permission controls. Source regression, protected qualification and containing served acceptance are separate evidence.
